repaired_findings.repair: Pre-launch binding, provider, capability, decoder, probe, scrubber, spec, and conformance coherence validation now refuses mismatches with zero launches.
Launch receipts now report one launcher call for the current invocation and store the current launch record instead of cumulative or first-launch metadata.
Decoder exceptions and undecoded outcomes now produce incomplete validation and evidence axes.
State-probe capture or mutation-observation failures now fail closed, skip domain decoding, and return no typed domain result.
Process cancellation remains unimplemented and is now explicitly declared as a v0 non-capability.
